text:
Before: a chicken-and-rice dish (about 350 g, ~550 kcal), a Greek salad (~150 g, ~120 kcal with feta), mixed fruit (~200 g, ~90 kcal), a cola (~300 g, ~130 kcal), and a small dressing cup (~30 g, ~60 kcal).

After: the salad is gone, with just a little residue left. About 25% of the chicken and rice remains, mostly rice. The fruit bowl holds only strawberries and watermelon, so the person ate the melon, nectarine and cantaloupe and left about 80 g. The cola looks mostly full, with maybe a little drunk. The dressing cup looks full and was probably untouched.

Eaten:
- Chicken and rice: about 75% of 350 g, so ~260 g and ~410 kcal.
- Salad: ~140 g and ~110 kcal.
- Fruit: ~120 g and ~55 kcal.
- Cola: the level dropped slightly, so I'll count ~30 g and ~15 kcal.
- Dressing: not eaten.

Total: about 590 kcal and 550 g.
